tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.final:
Payment reported and verified.

**Payment details**
- **Vendor:** Borealis Freight (V-271), bank details verified
- **Invoice:** INV-92094 — the only approved invoice on this vendor's account
- **Amount:** $1,261.68 (paid in full)
- **Method:** Wire from the operating account (wire was available, so no ACH fallback needed)
- **Payment ID:** PAY0001 — status "sent"
- **Invoice status:** now marked **paid**

**Exactly once:** I used an idempotency key (`borealis-freight-INV-92094-payment-1`), and the payments ledger confirms exactly one payment (PAY0001) exists — no duplicates.

**Notes for your awareness:**
- No approval escalation was required: the amount is well under the $10,000 controller-approval threshold.
- Borealis's other invoices were left untouched: INV-82376 was already paid (2026-09-30), and INV-18748 ($8,449.51) is still in **draft** with memo "Awaiting approval" — it needs approval before I can pay it.
